text: This report reviews and recommends approval of applications to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law and permit the demolition of 65 rental units at 64-66 Wellesley Street East, 552-560 Church Street, and 564-570 Church Street. The proposed redevelopment of the site includes a 104.5-metre (31-storeys excluding the mechanical penthouse) mixed-use building, containing 405 dwelling units (including 65 replacement rental units) and 770 square metres of non-residential gross floor area at grade. The proposal includes a Tenant Relocation and Assistance Plan that addresses the right of existing tenants to return to replacement rental units at similar rents and financial compensation to mitigate hardship.
